expectations.text: Describes the release model: year-based naming with an annual cycle (summer publication, effective January 1 following; ISA2028 expected summer 2027)
expectations.evidence: "I cannot reliably describe the final content of a catalogue called ISA2027" — no year-based naming or annual cycle described.

expectations.text: IS module: 46 controls retained, with analyses counting ~44 edited and substantive requirement changes in ~25 (counts attributed to analyses, not ENX)
expectations.evidence: No IS-module counts; only speculative "likely direction of change".

expectations.text: Prototype module: restructured from five control groups to TWO domains — Organizational Requirements and Physical & Environmental Security — at 20 controls, with new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return controls
expectations.evidence: Prototype changes only guessed ("possibly with updated expectations for digital capture and drones"); no two-domain / 20-control restructure.

expectations.text: New PTS label structure: Prototype Protection Basic (AL2) and Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), Facilities encompassing Basic
expectations.evidence: No PTS label structure (Basic AL2 / Facilities AL3) mentioned.

expectations.text: Mentions supply-chain strengthening (high: documented supplier monitoring; very high: TISAX label, equivalent assessment or supplier audit) and updated mappings (NIST CSF 2.0, refined ISO 27001:2022, 2013 references removed)
expectations.evidence: Supply-chain tightening only as a generic expectation "to be verified"; no high/very-high requirements, no NIST CSF 2.0 or 2013-removal for ISA2027.
